Package Controller.Design

Class QuestionController

java.lang.Object
Controller.Design.QuestionController
public class QuestionController extends Object
The QuestionController class manages all operations related to Question objects. It acts as a bridge between the UI and the QuestionStore, handling creation, retrieval, validation, and deletion of questions.
